blurb: Tempest Tours offers guided weather expeditions using company-owned heavy duty vans modified for comfort and safety with a maximum of 8 passengers. They provide weather briefings and presentations to enhance guest understanding of atmospheric dynamics. The team is skilled in weather photography and advises guests on capturing dynamic light.
